LightningComponentBundle.description: Embeds an external website in an iframe, using a URL stored on the record.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Heading shown on the card. Also used as the iframe's accessible title.

property.name: urlFieldApiName
property.label: URL Field API Name
property.description: Field on this record holding either a full https URL or an identifier to feed into the URL Template.

property.name: urlTemplate
property.label: URL Template
property.description: Destination URL, where {value} is replaced with the URL-encoded field value. Leave blank when the field already holds a full URL, or omit {value} for a fixed URL that is the same on every record.

property.name: frameHeight
property.label: Frame Height (px)
property.description: Height of the embedded frame in pixels.
